_ac_note: AC 11 = unarmored base from sheet. As Faber her role kit is Lorica Hamata+Scutum. Once she crafts Arcane Armor from that kit: AC 17 (14+DEX1+shield2). Update ac_override to 17 after session 1.
background_story: Comes from a city that was attacked while unprepared. Cannot leave broken equipment alone — compulsively repairs buckles, shafts, rivets in camp. Not efficiency: anxiety wearing the mask of productivity. Cannot stop because stopping means thinking about what she could not fix in time.
notes: Artificer Armorer (Guardian). Spellcasting INT, Spell DC 13, Spell Atk +5. Rock Gnome: Darkvision 60ft, Gnome Cunning (adv INT/WIS/CHA saves vs magic), Tinker. Infuse Item: 2 infusions/LR on up to 2 objects. Magical Tinkering 3/Other. Guardian Armor: Thunder Gauntlets +5/1d8+3 thunder, Thunder Gauntlets STR +4/1d8+2 thunder, Guardian Defensive Field +2 temp HP/Bonus Action. Proficiencies: Heavy+Light+Medium armor, Shields, Firearms, Simple weapons, Leatherworker+Smith+Thieves+Tinker tools. Passive Investigation 15.
